notes.title: Play Borderlands 3 for free this weekend!
notes.content:
Try Borderlands 3 during the Free Play weekend now through August 12!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/397540/Borderlands_3/

Borderlands 3 is free to play this weekend on select platforms. If you haven't yet embarked on your own Borderlands 3 adventure or you're looking to get some friends involved, now's the perfect time!

Between the start and end times listed below, you can enjoy everything that the Borderlands 3 base game has to offer. Power up your chosen Vault Hunter with killer weapons and superhuman abilities as you shoot and loot across multiple planets in pursuit of the diabolical Calypso Twins.

If you decide to purchase any edition of Borderlands 3 after the Free Play period ends, all your progress and loot will be saved so you can pick up right where you left off. To that end, Borderlands 3 is currently on sale as well; see the Steam store listing for additional details.

Steam Free Play

Starts: August 6, 8:00 AM PT / 11:00 AM ET / 4:00 PM BST / 11:00 PM UTC+8 / August 7, 1:00 AM AEDT
Ends: August 12, 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET / 6:00 PM BST / August 13, 1:00 AM UTC+8 / 3:00 AM AEDT

notes.title: Borderlands 2 VR Quality of Life Patch: January 29, 2020
notes.content:
Today, we will release a patch for Borderlands 2 VR that adds support for the Valve Index headset as well as some community-requested quality of life improvements!

Official Index Support
BL2VR now supports the Index headset!Added Index controller meshes, in-game controller layouts and created a new Index Binding as the default option for Knuckles controllers (named “2K Knuckles Config”)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35865371/0f5b7339edd7cef97aeeca6043778b078b427bed.png

Motion controller-based movement
Added an option in-game to change between head vs. MOVER-based movement
Scope Framerate Option
Added an option to choose between 30, 60, 90, and 120 FPS for the scope window

notes.title: Update To Address HTC Vive Distortion
notes.content:
An update has been pushed out for Borderlands 2 VR to address the scaling distortion that some players have reported experiencing on the HTC Vive headset. 

If you continue to experience issues after the update, please submit a ticket to support.2k.com
